description: Canonical text message. The Kotlin codec and the bridge firmware are both checked against this file so a change on one side cannot silently diverge from the other.
notes: Devanagari is transmitted as UTF-8, not escaped, so the payload stays 3 bytes per character instead of 6.
asrConfidence is quantised to whole percent (0.92 -> 92) because two decimals of a confidence score cost bytes and change no decision.
The frame header prepended by Framing is 49 54 01 followed by a 24-bit big-endian payload length.
